value.rationale: Coordinate volumes of polar Lipschitz-free balls are natural finite-dimensional Banach-space invariants in finite-metric volume-product geometry. The explicit all-n mixed incident-short-edge law fills a genuinely coupled deformation gap between distinct known endpoints; strict diminishing losses prove nonadditivity, while exact 1/n critical scaling identifies a structural dimension/metric singularity. This is not merely an isolated numerical value or a renaming of a known endpoint formula.
